title: MERN Stack + Gen AI
summary: Seventeen days of MERN interview essentials (JavaScript closures and the event loop, Node and Express, MongoDB and Mongoose, React, Redux Toolkit, testing and security), then thirteen days on building GenAI features into a MERN app: secure LLM calls, SSE streaming, structured output, embeddings, Atlas Vector Search, RAG, tool calling, cost control, AI safety and a system-design capstone.
